**Best move:** Rh1

**Motif:** hangingPiece

**Explanation:**
When your opponent's piece becomes undefended, attack it with a lower-value piece to force them to recapture at a loss. Black's queen on h2 is out of play after Rh1; capturing it with the rook trades rook for queen when White recaptures with the queen, winning material decisively. Watch for undefended pieces that can be attacked by a cheaper attacker—this pattern wins material constantly.
